verses.16:52: وَلَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَهُ ٱلدِّينُ وَاصِبًاۚ أَفَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ

meaning: The root وَصَبَ (w-ṣ-b) primarily means to be constant, continuous, or fixed. It also describes being diseased, ill, or in pain.
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
